es.q: Provide a comprehensive discussion of acute gastroenteritis in children, covering global burden and mortality trends, causative pathogen categories, pathophysiology, host and environmental risk factors, and clinical history assessment parameters.
es.m:
- **Global Burden & Mortality**: In 2015, diarrheal disease caused an estimated 499,000 child deaths (8.6% of all childhood deaths), making it the 4th most common cause of child mortality worldwide.
- **Episode Statistics**: Almost 1.0 billion episodes occurred in 2015, resulting in 45 million childhood disability-adjusted life years, with approximately 86% occurring in Africa and South Asia.
- **Mortality Decline Drivers**: Despite stable incidence, mortality declined by 39% over 2 decades due to preventive rotavirus vaccination, oral rehydration solution (ORS) therapy, and improved nutrition.
